title: How does offstage route a GUI command locally, and run cloud work on fleet Macs?
audience: Engineers onboarding to offstage and offstage cloud
scope: Local lane routing or refusal; cloud tasks, sandbox ops, agent runs, GitHub Actions jobs on fleet slots; console sign-in
omissions: Not shown: billing/mail/admin routes, container internals, slot RFB seeding, site/launch/bench

notes.title: Two places decide where work runs
notes.text: Locally, classify() picks headless, container or session; any refusing signal (installer, .dmg/.pkg, hdiutil) beats all three. In the cloud, boxes pull: the queue hands the fairest team's task to a slot whose offer covers its session (headless or gui).

notes.title: State is in memory, snapshotted to /data
notes.text: Tasks, sandboxes, boxes, accounts and ledger live in memory on one Fly machine and are written to DATA_FILE every 2 s when changed and on SIGTERM; a failed write is only logged. JIT runner configs and agent keys are memory-only.

notes.title: Failure, isolation and retry
notes.text: A claim not started within CLAIM_ACK_MS (20 s) is requeued, up to MAX_ATTEMPTS (3). A box unheard for BOX_LOST_MS (2 min) loses its work. A dirty slot is reset before its next claim, with backoff. Local lanes never fall back to the real screen.

views.title: Who calls the control plane?
views.scope: Entry point: the clients and the fleet box that call the plane; each flow is detailed in later views

notes.title: Pull model, no inbound ports
notes.text: The plane never calls a box. fleetd long-polls for work; client requests are held open until a box answers.

views.title: How does a local command get routed away from the real screen?
views.scope: Workflow A: classify, then the headless, container or session lane, or refuse

notes.title: Refuse beats route
notes.text: A refusing signal returns refuse and nothing runs. run() never throws and never falls back to the console screen.

views.title: How does a submitted task reach a slot and return its result?
views.scope: Workflow B: submit, queue, claim long-poll, run in the slot, report events

notes.title: Acked claims
notes.text: No 'started' within 20 s requeues the task, up to 3 attempts, then it fails never-started.

views.title: What persists, and how is a slot cleaned between customers?
views.scope: Plane snapshot and archive; per-slot reset after work

notes.title: Up to 2 s of state at risk
notes.text: Snapshot every 2 s on one machine; a crash loses unsaved changes, a failed write is only logged.

notes.title: Reset before next claim
notes.text: A slot that ran work is marked dirty; a failed reset keeps the mark and retries with backoff.

views.title: How does a sandbox op reach a slot?
views.scope: Workflow C: client op held open on the plane, fleetd ops long-poll, op runs in the slot
edgeLabels: C2 ops long-poll → op; POST answer
C3 run op as the slot user

notes.title: Held request, idempotent answer
notes.text: The plane keeps C1 open until fleetd answers or the op times out; a retried answer gets 200, not 409.

views.title: How does a computer-use agent run reach the model?
views.scope: Workflow D: agent op via fleetd, loop in the slot, model calls via the plane's proxy
edgeLabels: D2 ops poll → agent op + run token
D3 launch gui agent in slot

notes.title: Key stays on the plane
notes.text: x-anthropic-api-key is held in memory for the run; the slot gets an omt_ token that dies with it. Headless sandbox → 409.

views.title: How does a GitHub Actions job run on a fleet slot?
views.scope: Workflow E: webhook, JIT runner config, claim through fleetd, runner in a slot
edgeLabels: E4 start runner as slot user
E5 runner: run job, report result

notes.title: Config lost → not claimable
notes.text: jitConfig is memory-only; a runner task without one after a restart is not handed to a box.

views.title: How does a console user sign in?
views.scope: Workflow F: Clerk sign-in in the browser, server-side token check

notes.title: Checked server-side
notes.text: The plane verifies each Clerk token; unreachable Clerk → 502, bad token → 401.
